progressive_consolidation_process.description: Categories were progressively consolidated starting with Batch 0 as initial, then each subsequent batch was consolidated with the growing consolidated taxonomy

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Smart Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Intelligent dimmer switches with wireless connectivity, app control capabilities, and smart home integration features for remote brightness adjustment, e.g. WiFi enabled dimmers, voice assistant compatible dimmers, smartphone controlled dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Slide Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches with sliding control mechanism for adjusting light levels through linear motion, e.g. linear slide controls, vertical slide dimmers, slide bar dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Toggle Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches with traditional toggle or flip switch design combined with dimming functionality, e.g. toggle style dimmers, flip switch dimmers, traditional toggle dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Rotary Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches controlled by rotating knob or dial mechanism for brightness adjustment, e.g. dial control dimmers, knob operated dimmers, circular control dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Rocker Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches with rocker-style actuator combined with dimming controls for brightness adjustment, e.g. paddle style dimmers, rocker button dimmers, decorator style dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Remote Control Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches that include separate wireless remote control functionality for brightness adjustment, e.g. magnetic remote dimmers, handheld remote dimmers, wireless remote operated dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Multi Location Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches specifically designed for multi-location or companion dimming setups allowing control from multiple points, e.g. companion dimmers, multi-location controls, master-remote dimmer systems

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Standard Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Traditional wired dimmer switches without smart connectivity or specific control mechanism designation for basic brightness control, e.g. universal dimmers, LED dimmers, incandescent dimmers, general purpose dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Specialty Dimmer Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches designed for specific applications or with unique features beyond standard dimming functions, e.g. fan control dimmers, dual dimmers, plug-in dimmers, outdoor dimmers

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Smart On Off Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Intelligent on/off switches with wireless connectivity and app control capabilities for basic switching functions without dimming capability, e.g. WiFi switches, smart home compatible switches, voice controlled switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Single Pole Toggle Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Single pole toggle switches for basic on/off control from one location with flip lever mechanism, e.g. standard toggle switches, illuminated toggle switches, heavy duty toggle switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Single Pole Rocker Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Single pole rocker paddle switches for basic on/off control from one location with paddle mechanism, e.g. decorator rocker switches, quiet rocker switches, illuminated rocker switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Three Way Toggle Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Three way toggle switches for controlling lights from two locations with flip lever mechanism, e.g. grounding three way toggles, illuminated three way toggles, residential grade three way switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Three Way Rocker Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Three way rocker paddle switches for controlling lights from two locations with paddle mechanism, e.g. decorator three way rockers, commercial grade three way paddles, grounding three way switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Four Way Toggle Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Four way toggle switches for controlling lights from three or more locations with flip lever mechanism, e.g. framed four way toggles, commercial grade four way switches, grounding four way toggles

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Four Way Rocker Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Four way rocker paddle switches for controlling lights from three or more locations with paddle mechanism, e.g. decorator four way rockers, commercial grade four way paddles, self grounding four way switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Double Pole Toggle Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Double pole toggle switches for controlling high voltage circuits with dual pole switching capability, e.g. commercial grade double pole toggles, quiet double pole switches, grounding double pole toggles

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Multi Gang Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Switches with multiple controls in a single unit for operating multiple lights independently, e.g. double switches, triple switches, duplex switches, triple rocker switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Multi Way Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Switches designed for controlling lights from multiple locations through coordinated switching, e.g. three way switches, four way switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Single Pole Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Basic on/off switches for controlling lights from one location with simple switching functionality, e.g. paddle switches, rocker switches, toggle switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Illuminated Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: On/off switches with built-in LED indicators or night light features for visibility and status indication, e.g. lighted switches, LED indicator switches, night light switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Specialty Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Switches with unique features or specific applications beyond standard switching functions, e.g. pilot light switches, locator light switches, push button switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Combination Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Switches combined with outlets or other electrical devices in a single unit, e.g. switch outlet combinations, duplex receptacle combinations, combo wall switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Wireless Remote Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Battery operated or RF controlled switches without hardwiring for remote operation, e.g. remote control switches, wireless wall switches, no wiring switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Sound Activated Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Switches activated by sound or clapping for hands-free operation, e.g. clap on switches, sound detection switches, voice activated switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Door Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Switches specifically designed for door lighting control with automatic activation, e.g. door light switches, automatic door switches, door activated switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: Add On Switch
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Auxiliary switches used with smart switch systems for extended control points, e.g. paddle add on switches, companion switches, auxiliary wall switches

final_consolidated_taxonomies.name: OUT_OF_SCOPE
final_consolidated_taxonomies.definition: Products that are accessories, components, or clearly don't belong to wall switches, e.g. companion switches, accessory switches, remote controls, inline cord switches, appliance switches, lamp switches
